title: Eyes in the Shadows
description: Three towns, three people gone, and nobody has laid them side by side yet. Dalhurst, Thornfield, Millbrook. Look at all three and tell Severin what ties them, and draw no attention doing it.

objectives.description: Receive your briefing from Severin Vane
Travel to Thornfield to continue the investigation
Travel to Millbrook for the final piece
Lay the three sites side by side
Tell Severin it is a labor racket, not a cult

notes: Finding now stated per audit ('finding is never stated'): the three disappearances share one detail - a fake job posting with no traceable employer, i.e. a quiet labor-trafficking operation rather than the cult the description originally implied. Not tied to the soulstone undercurrent (this quest has no touchpoint assignment in docs/design/quest_web.md) and does not touch any bible [OPEN]. Invented for this quest only, prose only, no new NPC or item ids.
